description: AI-agent readiness audit of a website: score 0-100, grade and verdict across agent access (robots.txt rules for AI bots, bot challenges), readable content (raw HTML, markdown), discovery (llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, meta/OG), agent interfaces (OpenAPI, MCP, A2A agent card, x402) and speed/HTTPS. Free preview tier: score, grade and category scores. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005) and /v1/audit ($0.03) add the findings, prioritized fixes and ready-to-paste snippets (llms.txt draft, robots.txt lines, JSON-LD).

url.description: Website URL or domain to audit, e.g. https://example.com or stripe.com (public http/https only)

name: audit_website
title: Is this website ready for AI agents?
